director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch ki tarah dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Riya, pitch ko 4 equal parts mein baanto: har hissa one-fourth hoga. Number line par pehle hissa ka point kahan aayega? Golu ko tum sikhaogi.
Koi baat nahi, Riya. 0 se 1 tak 4 equal gaps banao; pehla point 1/4 hoga. Ab 2/4 kis gap par hai?
Riya, 2/4, 4th gap nahi—0 se doosra gap. Ab hamare example mein 0 se 1 ko kitne equal gaps mein baantna hai?
Riya, denominator 5 batata hai ki 0 se 1 tak 5 equal gaps honge. Ab 2/5 middle se pehle hai ya baad?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: Riya, ab wahi check: 2/5, middle ke pehle hai ya baad, kyunki 2/5, 1/2 se less hai? Apna answer bolo.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: Riya, 6 number nahi, position ka word chahiye. 2/5 middle ke kis taraf hai, jab woh 1/2 se less hai? Try karo.

director.text: Example ke liye, 3/8 ko 1/2 se compare karo: 3/8, half se pehle aayega ya baad? Ab 2/5 ke liye batao.

director.text: Ab number line par ek naya fraction dekhenge; pehle equal parts ko dhyaan se count karna. Ghar (0) se chai ki dukaan (1) tak ki sadak 2 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Beech wale mark par kaunsa number hai?
